submitted.rationale: All five EQE measurements came out at about zero (≤1e-4 %), which is within noise. That fits the 2.1 eV illumination being below the band gaps of the Bi–Sb–O phases (Bi2O3, Bi3SbO7, BiSbO4 are all wider than about 2.5 eV). Index 5 (Sb 0.08, near Bi12SbO20 sillenite) gave the highest measured value, 9e-5 %, but that is not meaningfully better than the others.
